cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(ICAXKDL LANGUAGES CXX)
string(REPLACE "/RTC1" "" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG}")
set(kdl_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/orocos_kinematics_dynamics-db25b7e480e068df068232064f2443b8d52a83c7/orocos_kdl")
set(KDL_VERSION_MAJOR 1)
set(KDL_VERSION_MINOR 5)
set(KDL_VERSION_PATCH 1)
set(KDL_VERSION "1.5.1")
set(HAVE_STL_CONTAINER_INCOMPLETE_TYPES ON)
configure_file("${kdl_root}/src/config.h.in" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl/config.h")
file(GLOB headers "${kdl_root}/src/*.hpp" "${kdl_root}/src/*.inl")
file(COPY ${headers} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl")
file(COPY "${kdl_root}/src/utilities" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl")
# DLL consumers must import KDL's public epsilon data symbol explicitly.
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl/utilities/utility.h" utility)
string(REPLACE "extern double     epsilon;" "#if defined(_WIN32) && defined(ICAX_KDL_IMPORT)\n__declspec(dllimport)\n#endif\nextern double     epsilon;" utility "${utility}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl/utilities/utility.h" "${utility}")
file(GLOB_RECURSE sources "${kdl_root}/src/*.cpp" "${kdl_root}/src/*.cxx")
add_library(orocos-kdl SHARED ${sources})
set_target_properties(orocos-kdl PROPERTIES WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
target_compile_features(orocos-kdl PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(orocos-kdl PUBLIC NOMINMAX)
target_include_directories(orocos-kdl PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/kdl" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../coal/eigen-3.4.0")
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_options(orocos-kdl PRIVATE /O2 /Ob2 /MP4 /utf-8 /wd4244 /wd4267)
endif()
install(TARGETS orocos-kdl RUNTIME DESTINATION bin ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/" DESTINATION include)
install(FILES "${kdl_root}/COPYING" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/README.md" DESTINATION licenses)

option(ICAX_KDL_TESTS "Build neutral adapter regression" OFF)
if(ICAX_KDL_TESTS)
 add_executable(kdl-pose-tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tests/icax-plugins/cam/MachinePoseIKTests.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../iCAX-Plugins/cam/Machine/MachinePoseIK.cpp")
 target_compile_definitions(kdl-pose-tests PRIVATE _MACHINE ICAX_KDL_IMPORT)
 target_link_libraries(kdl-pose-tests PRIVATE orocos-kdl)
endif()
